messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now.  

If you need the current time, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock, or a time‑zone converter. New York is in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑5 during standard time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time).

But we might need to use a function? There's no function for time. We can compute based on UTC. But we don't know current UTC. We could approximate using system time? We don't have that. We can respond that we don't have real-time capability. We can say we can't provide real-time. Or we can approximate using known offset: New York is UTC-4 during daylight saving. But we don't know if DST is in effect. We can mention that. Probably best to say we don't have real-time.
